open_issues: Concurrent package churn in src/Wakeel.Reports and src/Wakeel.Desktop/Services/LetterPdfWriter.cs (the B3 letter package's live, uncommitted work) broke 'dotnet build src/Wakeel.Desktop' four times during this session with errors inside files I do not own (CS0723/CS0721/CS0051 on WakeelPaths, then CS1501/CS0535/CS1503 in Wakeel.Reports/Letters/*). Each time I waited and retried per protocol; the final retry is green (0 warnings, 0 errors) and every file I changed compiles. Nothing was edited in those projects.

W08's monthly-report banner still shows 0% with the neutral sentence because ReadinessService does not exist until B5. The layout is now the export's single row, so only the figure has to change when B5 lands.
W94 still draws the assignee field where the export draws correspondence linking - accepted by supervisor ruling 9 until B4 brings correspondence linking.

The sort pill of W09 uses the 'clock' icon: the icon registry has no ascending/descending-bars glyph, and 'clock' is the closest honest reading of the delay sort. If the registry gains a sort glyph, swap it.
notes:
GIT STATUS FIRST. A previous attempt of this round had already closed the two MEDIUM findings before the connection dropped, and I verified that in the files rather than redoing them: W94QuickCapture.razor.css carries `.w94 > ::deep .w-field { width: 100% }` (finding 1) and WTabItem.razor.css draws the active tab as the filled primary pill with the count on a translucent ground (finding 2, ruling 1). Both were re-confirmed in the running host.

FINDING BY FINDING.
3 + 12 (W09, ruling 3) - the export's second control strip now sits under the tabs: a filter menu over the types actually present in the open tab, a sort control for longest-delay-first, and the live summary counted from the visible rows (it says there is no delay at all rather than printing a zero). The list export in the header saves a tab-separated Arabic file through the same IFileSaveService the health report uses; every cell is formula-escaped (a leading =, +, - or @ gets an apostrophe) and tabs/newlines are flattened, so a subject beginning with an equals sign stays a subject. The footer now reads the export's wording with a counted noun per tab (late/near/stale/pending), and the delay cell carries the bucket's semantic dot.
  The FIRST cut of this strip used a labelled WSelect and a WToggle. Putting the host photo beside design/exports/preview/dark/W/W09 showed the export draws both controls as compact PILLS on one line with the search - so I re-cut it: WMenu gained a first-class named trigger (Label/Icon/Tooltip -> `.w-menu-trigger--pill`, shaped like a secondary button) in the design system, and the sort is a WButton that fills in (Primary) while it is on. The dot is a new shared `.w-dot` / `.w-dot--danger|warning|success|muted` utility in the design system's app.css, not a page-local ornament, as the finding asked.
4 + 5 (W08, ruling 6) - WBanner gained a TrailingContent slot between the sentence and the buttons (flex:none), and W08 moved WProgressBar out of BodyContent into it, so the monthly banner is one row: cycle sentence, readiness bar with its figure, link to the monthly report. The sync card now carries a WSectionHeader with an icon WButton (tooltip: re-read the sync state) that calls ReloadAsync.
6 (W10, ruling 4) - one continuous list. The service's day groups still decide the order (today, then yesterday, then older) but nothing names them on screen; `.w10-group`, the WSectionHeader day heads, GroupLabel and the now-dead GroupToday/GroupYesterday/GroupOlder constants are all gone.
7 (ruling 5) - W11ClockBanner moved below `.w-page-header` (still above `.w-page-content`) in MainLayout.
8 - W91's row gap is 8px and the sheet's block gap 12px (column gap untouched at 16px). 10px still left 2px of scroll; 8px clears it.
9 + 10 (ruling 10) - Ar.Health.ExportFileName(stamp) and Ar.QuickCapture.AppointmentTimePlaceholder replace the two inline literals; the hh:mm parse is unchanged.
11 (ruling 7) - W08, W09 and W12 subscribe to ShellServices.Changed and re-read on the NEXT render, never inside the event (the session announces an unlock while it is still writing to the database the read would use), unsubscribing in Dispose. Two bUnit tests drive a real lock/unlock through LockService and assert the screen picks up work that arrived meanwhile.
Note 2 (ruling 8) - IQuickCaptureService.CaptureTaskAsync gained an optional `noteAr` before the cancellation token; the note goes into TaskItem.Description in the same save, W94 passes it there, and the package-local ITaskNotes/TaskNotes plus its DI line are deleted. New Core test file with five facts, including that one undo soft-deletes the task WITH its note.

SIDE-BY-SIDE (host at 1366x768 with a CDP device-metrics override, three freshly seeded temporary folders, each preview opened once).
W09 vs the export - now the same anatomy: header with handle-next, export and refresh; filled tab pill; the three controls on ONE line at one height (search 717-1106, filter pill 615-705, sort pill 465-603, summary pushed to the end), measured, no overlap; seven columns; the red dot before the delay; the footer's record noun. No horizontal overflow anywhere (.w-page 1134/1134). The filter menu opens with its two real entries and the sort pill really fills in.
W08 - banner one row (sentence, bar, 0%, link), refresh in the sync card's header, filled tab pill. Deviation left: the 0% readiness (spec, B5).
W10 - five rows, ZERO section headers, kind icon on the row's start edge and the unread dot on its end, filled all-tab pill with its real count.
W11 (skewed-clock folder) - banner at y=151, between the page header at y=78 and the page content at y=255: the title and its two buttons are no longer pushed down.
W12 - eleven cards, last-check line on every tile's start edge, status chips on the end edge, no overflow.
W91 - .w-page 712/712 with all thirteen cards in the export's 5/5/3, nothing below the fold.
W94 - all three single fields measure 520px, exactly the dialog's content box, and the time field placeholder is Arabic words.
Every host process was killed; the three logs hold only the one startup line and no error. Zero Wakeel.Desktop processes remain.

RULES. No NuGet package added. Nothing outside the allowed paths was touched (the Core change is the one additive parameter in QuickCaptureService.cs; the Core test is one new file). Every new Arabic string lives in Ar.Shell.cs; no technical term, format token, error code, port, server or database wording anywhere; the new icon-only control carries a tooltip; the exported file is written only through a save dialog the person drives. TreatWarningsAsErrors is on and nothing was suppressed: 0 warnings on every project I build.
